name: Home organising and decluttering
summary: How expats hire professional organisers in Singapore for move-ins, HDB/condo space constraints, and pre-move declutter — including disposal rules and what organisers do not replace (movers, cleaners).
body:
Professional organisers help sequence decisions when a 40-foot container meets a 3-bedroom condo. Services range from wardrobe systems to full move-in setups and “leave Singapore” declutter sprints.

## Typical engagements
- Post-move unpack and zone setup
- Kids’ rooms and dual-career closet systems
- Pre-departure sell/donate/dispose plans
- Document and admin stations for visa-heavy households
- Kitchen resets after grocery reality in humid weather

Organisers are not cleaners, handymen, or movers — many partner with those trades. Ask who buys shelving and who owns disposal runs.

## Disposal and rules
Condo bulky-waste and HDB disposal norms apply. E-waste and confidential document shredding need proper channels. Do not assume the organiser will quietly dump renovation waste down the chute.

## How to choose
Prefer organisers who start with a scoped walkthrough, hourly or project quotes in writing, and clear boundaries on shopping commissions. Look at before/after photos of similar flat sizes — landed-house portfolios mis-set expectations. Trial a single zone (entry closet) before a whole-home contract.

## Practical tip
Declutter before the mover quote when leaving — volume drives cost. Photograph “before” shelves for landlord inventory debates later, and keep a donate-receipt folder for any corporate relocation policy claims.
